diagnosis: The check C6 passed in three out of four rollouts because the model defaulted to the exact 1,800-liter Line Y requirement, as specified in PF1. This default setting allowed the model to satisfy the check without needing the hidden information provided by the other agents.

C6.why: The 1,800 conductivity result and the exact 1,800-liter Line Y requirement change the allocation from an unspecified or broad reclaimed-water plan to Line Y only with exactly 1,800 liters and a recorded conductivity test.

fix_instructions: Tighten check C6 to require a flexible volume range instead of an exact 1,800 liters. For example, modify the check to allow any volume between 1,500 and 2,000 liters, ensuring that the model cannot rely on the exact value of PF1 to pass the check. Update the flips for check C6 to include a new fact ID, such as 'PF1_fluid_range', which specifies the acceptable volume range.
